verdict.summary: The change correctly centralizes unknown-label reduction and post-reduction safety checks in scripts/triage.py, preserves retriage's fail-closed action gate through thin adapters, and adds the missing last-mile validation to triage.py --apply. Unsafe reduced plans are logged and become no-op successes, while safe reductions and complete-label plans still reach the existing fail-loud applier. The tests exercise real classifier output, both lane-invariant halves, premise reclassification, exception refusal, wrapper identity/action behavior, and end-to-end entry-point accept/refuse paths with literal expected values. I found no correctness, soundness, security, or test-vacuity issue in the diff.
